blocks.text: Deuteronomy 11 contains 32 verses. It opens with: Therefore thou shalt love Jehovah thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his ordinances, and his commandments, alway. It concludes with: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you this day. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: The repeated instruction is rhetorically adapted covenant exposition for a successor generation, not a simple verbatim duplication of earlier laws.
